title: SOP - App startup connect timeout troubleshooting
content: When app startup shows connect timeout: check DB host/port, validate network policy, then verify DB readiness and connection limits.

title: SOP - Gateway 502 troubleshooting
content: For gateway 502: inspect upstream app health, verify service discovery entries, then validate route target and timeout settings.

title: Case - Redis connection refused after deployment
content: Connection refused is usually caused by wrong redis endpoint, port closed by policy, or redis service not started.

title: SOP - Database timeout and authentication troubleshooting
content: If DB timeout/auth errors occur: confirm endpoint reachability, username/password, DB listener, and whitelist rules.
